item.guhs.guhwinter_pepernoot.lore: Spicy, round and worth a lot on the Winterplein. Yum!
guhwinter.kern.klik.hover: Click: the Winterplein goes into your Reisguh list, and you see the way.
guhwinter.kern.login.sint: Sinterklaas got lost in the Guhmension! He took the wrong turn at Slot Loevestijn... Come and help on the Winterplein. Hooray! %s
guhwinter.kern.login.pakjesavond: Bonk bonk bonk! Someone is knocking on the door... It's pakjesavond on the Winterplein! %s
guhwinter.kern.login.kerst: The fire is crackling at Papa Krijn and Mama Corine's: it's Christmas on the Winterplein! Bring a warm chocomel. %s
guhwinter.kern.login.oudjaar: Can you smell that? Oliebollen! The guhs celebrate New Year's Eve on the Winterplein. What's your resolution? %s
guhwinter.kern.nieuw.pakjesavond: Bonk bonk bonk! Someone is knocking on the door... It's PAKJESAVOND! Hurry to the Winterplein! %s
guhwinter.kern.nieuw.kerst: Sinterklaas is on his way home again (turning right at Slot Loevestijn this time). Now it's CHRISTMAS on the Winterplein! Joost and Niels are fetching a tree... by train?! %s
guhwinter.kern.nieuw.oudjaar: The Christmas tree drawings have been handed out and the oliebollen are sizzling: NEW YEAR'S EVE on the Winterplein! Who bakes the tastiest one? %s
guhwinter.kern.einde: The snow has melted and the Winterplein is empty again. Thank you for a cosy Guhwinter! Something new will come to the party square later. HOORAY!
guhwinter.kern.geen_bouw: The Winterplein belongs to everyone: no building or breaking here. Nope!
guhwinter.kern.smelt.item: Your %s melted! Winter is over... bye bye, see you next year!
guhwinter.kern.cmd.waar: The %s is in your Reisguh list now! Talk to a Reisguh in the Guhmension and pick it. You can walk too: it's right next to the Guh portal at spawn (x %s, z %s).
guhwinter.kern.cmd.waar.voorbij: The Guhwinter is over. The party square is waiting for the next party!
guhwinter.kern.cmd.datum.gezet: Guhwinter date (dev) is now %s: phase %s. The clock keeps running from here.
guhwinter.kern.cmd.datum.echt: Guhwinter date: the real one again (%s, phase %s).
guhwinter.kern.cmd.datum.fout: '%s' is not a date. Like this: 2026-12-05 18:59 (or 'echt').
guhwinter.kern.cmd.moment.opnieuw: Moment %s fires again as soon as its time has passed.
guhwinter.kern.cmd.status.geen: No moments left: it's all over.
